architecture.mechanism: Tissue-specific regulatory promoters selectively switch transcription of target genes on or off only in the subsystem where they are needed, confining activity to the required location.
architecture.intervention: Install a powertrain-warranty-covered selective-control module (promoter analog) that enables fuel-injector shutoff and cylinder deactivation only for the affected lower-end bank of the V8, isolating the grinding, no-power, raw-fuel condition to the flagged cylinders while the remaining bank continues normal combustion.
architecture.expected_effect: Selective regulation cuts fuel to the damaged cylinders, eliminating the raw fuel odor and popping, reducing hydrodynamic load on the grinding lower-end components, and restoring usable power without a full engine replacement.
architecture.falsification_test: Run a before/after dynamometer and exhaust test with the module disabled versus enabled; log exhaust hydrocarbon ppm and sound pressure level (dB) at the oil pan at idle, and confirm powertrain warranty coverage in writing, if the enabled state does not measurably reduce HC and grinding dB, the mechanism is falsified.
